I've written the calculator in Nim (`src/calc.nim`) along with `build.sh`. It builds and passes all 6 example cases with `node check.mjs`.

Beyond the examples, I spot-checked edge cases by hand and the results matched the spec:
- `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives `0`, and `-9223372036854775807-1` gives the minimum value.
- `-9223372036854775808` prints `error`, because the literal itself is too large.
- `-(4611686018427387904)*2` succeeds, because unary minus binds tighter than `*`. Overf
